text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho arrives for training and 
immediately throws a tantrum, saying she 
doesn't feel like running. However, she 
keeps sneaking glances at her Trainer's 
expression.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she truly had no motivation, she 
wouldn't have come here. Believing there 
must be a reason, I wait quietly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, Sweep Tosho began to bare her heart. 
"Trust me. Listen to what I have to say. 
Don't try to hold me back just by 
insisting your way is right!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And after acknowledging her Trainer, she 
confides the race she wants to aim for. 
Setting her sights on the Oka Sho, her 
search for the magic of racing begins 
anew.
